instruction: Of the German companies that are world market leaders for (i) pharmaceutical blister packaging machines, (ii) film-stretching lines, and (iii) thermoforming packaging machines, which was founded most recently? Answer with the company name.

provenance.note: Uhlmann 1948 < Brueckner 1960 < Multivac 1961 -> Multivac most recent. Two of three within one year -> requires precise retrieval.
